courses.name: Survey of Artificial Intelligence I: Basic Techniques
courses.prerequisites: Must have credit for CSE 2331 or 5221; and Math 2568, 2174, 4568, or 5520H; and Stat 3201 or 3450 or 3460 or 3470 or 4201 or Math 4530 or 5530H; and enrollment in CSE, CIS, ECE, or Data Analytics major. Not open to students with credit for 5521.

courses.name: Machine Learning and Statistical Pattern Recognition
courses.prerequisites: Must have credit for CSE 3521, 5521, or 5243; and 5522, Stat 3460, or 3470; and Math 2568, 2174, 4568, or 5520H.

courses.name: Foundations of Speech and Language Processing
courses.prerequisites: Must have credit for CSE 3521 or 5521, and 5522, Stat 3460, or 3470.

courses.name: Introduction to Neural Networks
courses.prerequisites: Must have credit for CSE 3521 or 5521.

courses.name: Introduction to Data Mining
courses.prerequisites: Must have credit for CSE 3241 or 5241; and 2331, 5331, Stat 3301, or ISE 3200; and enrollment in CSE, CIS, ECE, Data Analytics, or ISE major.

courses.name: Capstone: Knowledge-Based Systems
courses.prerequisites: Must have credit for CSE 3521, or 5521; and 2501, or Philos 1338, or 2338; and CSE 3901, or 3902, or 3903; and GE writing and comm course: level 2, or GE foundation writing and info literacy course.

requirements.title: AI specialization
requirements.summary: Complete the required course and two listed options. Credits vary if the four-credit capstone is selected.

requirements.title: Parent degree and specialization selection
requirements.summary: A specialization is required within BSCSE or BSCIS; students typically select it when applying to the major and contact an advisor to change it.

requirements.title: Course enrollment conditions
requirements.summary: Meet the prerequisites and enrollment restrictions attached to each listed course. An asterisk on a listed course denotes undergraduate petition eligibility; none of the inspected AI rows is starred.

requirements.title: Relationship to BS CSE technical electives
requirements.summary: The specialization supplies part of the BS CSE technical electives. The parent degree requires 17 technical-elective hours, including 9 CSE hours; these are parent totals, not additional AI-specialization credits.

requirements.title: Relationship to BS CIS technical electives
requirements.summary: The specialization supplies part of the BS CIS technical electives. The parent degree requires 16 technical-elective hours, including 9 CSE hours; these are parent totals, not additional AI-specialization credits.

requirements.title: BS CIS AI preparation exception
requirements.summary: Linear algebra remains required for the AI specialization through CSE 3521 prerequisites even though the general BS CIS core replaces MATH 2568. Use the listed CSE 3521 alternatives; no waiver is inferred.

notes: Complete designation covers the AI specialization requirement inventory and governing local/parent-relationship policies, not either whole bachelor degree.

Parent BS CSE and BS CIS technical-elective totals (17 and 16 hours) are relationship notes, not extra specialization requirements to add. BS CIS AI students still need linear algebra through CSE 3521 preparation.
